Data that is streamed can be manipulated on a rooted/jailbroken vehicle; as such, our platform makes a call to Tesla's official servers to retrieve both staged and installed release notes.

These release notes cannot be tampered with and are the ultimate source of truth.

Screenshots (and even recordings) of the official Tesla mobile app can not be trusted, as payloads can be intercepted and modified using various MITM tools.

The only way to truly verify whether updates are legitimate is to connect a vehicle to a platform like ours.

We've seen posts circulating about V14 Lite being available or released to some HW3 vehicles.

As far as we have determined, these posts are entirely fabricated, and we can confirm that no such update has been released to customer vehicles.

V14 Lite is still expected this month.
